Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects. You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

Job : Cyber Security Consultant (Junior/Medior)

Location: Diegem Area

Hybrid (2 days remote, on-site presence required)

Contract: Open-ended (employee status, CDI)

Start Date: ASAP

I am currently looking for a Junior/Medior Cybersecurity Consultant to enforce the cybersecurity team of one of our partners. 
 

Key Responsibilities

• Advise clients on cybersecurity governance and security frameworks.
• Conduct security and cyber risk assessments.
• Develop and improve security policies, processes, and control frameworks.
• Support compliance and implementation initiatives related to ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2, COBIT, NIST, OWASP, and CIS Controls.
• Deliver security awareness and training initiatives.
• Lead client engagements and provide practical recommendations to improve security maturity.

Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• 3-6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, IT risk, GRC, or security consulting.
• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2, COBIT, NIST, OWASP, and CIS Controls.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor) are a plus.
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is an asset.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Specialist L1 - Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:
We are looking for a proactive and customer-oriented IT Support Specialist to join our client's team in Brussels. You will play a key role in providing first- and second-line technical support to end users within a dynamic service-driven environment.

This position requires excellent English communication skills, a strong service mindset, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural setting.

• Provide first IT support to internal users (onsite and remote)
• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues
• Manage and track incidents and service requests using a ticketing system
• Install, configure, and maintain IT equipment (laptops, desktops, mobile devices)
• Support Microsoft environments (Windows, Office 365, Teams, etc.)
• Escalate complex issues to higher-level support teams when required
• Ensure timely resolution of incidents within SLAs
• Deliver a high level of customer service and user satisfaction
• Contribute to IT documentation and knowledge base

Profile

• Previous experience in IT support / Service Desk / Helpdesk - max 3 years of experience
• Strong knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft 365, and basic networking
• Excellent communication skills in English (mandatory) - both written and spoken
• Customer-focused attitude with strong interpersonal skills
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently
• Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks efficiently

Passionate about cloud-native platforms? Join a fast-growing software company and grow your expertise in Kubernetes and platform engineering

Our partner, a software company specialized in delivering tech softwares is looking for his/her next talent ✨

If you thrive in complex environments and love solving operational challenges through engineering, they'd love to meet you.

You will be working on responsibilities, ensuring the resilience, performance, and automation of our production platforms.
DevOps Engineer - Tasks & Responsibilities
• Design, operate, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based production platforms.
• Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, Ansible or similar).
• Enhance platform reliability, observability, monitoring, and incident response following SRE best practices.
• Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
• Collaborate with development teams to improve application performance, scalability, and operational excellence.
DevOps Engineer - The Match
• Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, or SRE in cloud-native environments.
• Strong hands-on expertise with Kubernetes (mandatory), including cluster administration and troubleshooting.
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization, Linux, networking, and automation.
• Solid knowledge of observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, etc.) and DevOps tooling.
• Professional proficiency inEnglish and French(both written and spoken).

Shape security strategies, ensure compliance with international standards, and contribute to building a resilient security culture.

Passionate about cybersecurity governance and risk? Join our partner, a leading professional services firm that values work-life balance and puts people first. Continue to grow your skills while delivering real value to clients.
Cybersecurity Analyst - Tasks & Responsibilities
• Support and maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) in line with ISO 27001.
• Conduct risk assessments and define mitigation plans to strengthen the organization's security posture.
• Develop, review, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures.
• Coordinate internal and external security audits and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Raise cybersecurity awareness by supporting training initiatives and advising stakeholders on security best practices.
Cybersecurity Analyst - Profile
• Experience in cybersecurity governance, risk management, or information security compliance.
• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, ISO 27005, NIST CSF, or similar cybersecurity frameworks.
• Familiarity with risk assessment methodologies, audits, and security governance processes.
• Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Professional proficiency in English and Dutch(both written and spoken).

Lead Tech Security, boost cyber resilience & governance. Join a global leader, drive strategy, mentor teams, and shape secure digital futures.

Lead technology security oversight, strengthen enterprise cyber resilience, and ensure alignment with global security frameworks. We are partnering with a leading international organization that prioritizes innovation, operational excellence, and a people-first culture. 

This is a key role for an experienced security professional ready to supervise teams and drive strategic security initiatives across the business
Senior Supervisor - Tasks & Responsibilities
• Supervise and coordinate technology security operations across infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments.
• Oversee the implementation and continuous improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS), aligned with ISO 27001 and related standards.
• Lead risk management activities, including enterprise risk assessments, threat analysis, and mitigation planning.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and international standards (ISO 27001, ISO 27005, NIST CSF, GDPR).
• Coordinate internal/external audits and act as key liaison with auditors, regulators, and senior stakeholders.
• Guide incident response activities and support root cause analysis for security events.
• Supervise security governance activities, including policy development, review, and enforcement.
• Lead security awareness initiatives and promote a strong security culture across the organization.
• Mentor and support junior security staff and cross-functional teams.
Senior Supervisor - Profile
• Minimum5+ years of experiencein cybersecurity, information security governance, risk management, or security operations.
• Strong expertise inISO 27001, ISO 27005, NIST CSF, and related security frameworks.
• Proven experience in security audits, compliance programs, and risk assessment methodologies.
• Demonstrated ability to supervise teams and manage cross-functional security initiatives.
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including senior leadership interaction.
• Fluent inEnglish and Dutch (mandatory – written and spoken).
• Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor) are considered a strong asset.

Do you want to be a part of one of the fastest-growing and largest Security Operations Centers in Europe? Do you have a passion for Cyber Security, especially advanced Managed Detection & Response (MDR)? Does Incident Response, Digital Forensics, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence and everything related to Cyber Security feel like second nature to you? Are you a Cyber Defender at heart, driven to strengthen the blue team and help organizations that are under attack? If you answered yes to all of these questions, you might be the perfect fit for our CSIRT Analyst role.
 

• You handle security alerts/incidents that have been escalated by the SOC Analysts (Tier 2)
• You conduct DFIR assignments, including DFIR readiness assessments
• You participate in the weekly Threat Hunting duty to proactively chase threats through novel Tools, Techniques & Procedures (TTPs)
• You will perform compromise assessments to identify potential compromises and their scope
• You collect Threat Intelligence (IOCs and TTPs)
• You will contribute to Detection Engineering in SIEM, xDR, …
• Together with the Red Team you will do Purple Teaming exercises to test and improve defenses
• You contribute to the creation of playbooks in SOAR
• You will co-write processes and procedures related to DFIR, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, …
• You will be part of our Incident Response on call service.

Profile

• You have at least 3-5 years of experience in a similar position
• You have a bachelor or master degree or equivalent through experience
• You are able to perform forensically sound acquisition, parsing and analysis of disk, memory images, forensic artifacts and logs in order to rebuild the timeline of events for a cybersecurity incident. Extensive hands-on experience in this domain of expertise is mandatory
• You have experience and/or interest in working with the following MDR tools: EDR (CrowdStrike Falcon, MS Defender for Endpoint, Sentinel One, ...), NDR (Vectra, Darktrace, ...), xDR (CrowdStrike Identity Protection, MS Defender for Office/Clouds Apps/Identity/...)
• As an analyst or engineer, you already have a good knowledge of Security Monitoring with SIEM technologies
• You are passionate about the following security capabilities: Security Monitoring, Digital Forensics, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, ...
• You have a hands-on and proactive mindset with a 'can do' mentality
• You speak and write English fluently.

jobs.occupation: Backend Software Engineer | AI & SaaS Sector
jobs.description:
Our partner, an innovative technology company active in the AI and SaaS space, is looking for a Backend Software Engineer to strengthen their engineering team.

Our partner is a fast-growing technology company developing a next-generation digital platform powered by artificial intelligence.

The company is building a modern SaaS solution designed to transform the way businesses operate by combining automation, data and AI-driven technologies.

Operating in an ambitious and innovative environment, the company offers a startup mindset with strong technical challenges, where engineers have a direct impact on the product and its evolution.
Backend Software Engineer | The role :
As a Backend Software Engineer, you will join a highly motivated engineering team and contribute to the development of a scalable AI-driven platform.

You will be responsible for designing, developing and improving backend services, mainly using TypeScript and Node.js.

You will work on core product features, architecture improvements and technical challenges linked to scalability, performance and reliability.

You will also actively participate in product discussions, technical decisions and prioritization sessions, having a real influence on both the technical direction and product evolution.

Backend Software Engineer | The profile :
• You have a Master’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent experience
• You have at least 5 years of experience in backend development
• You have strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript
• You have experience designing scalable backend solutions and APIs
• You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and making pragmatic technical decisions
• Experience with AI-driven applications, prompt engineering or machine learning concepts is a strong plus
• You are curious, proactive and eager to learn new technologies
• You are fluent in Englishand speak Dutch or French

For an international company operating in the logistics sector, we are looking for a Scrum Master who will play a key role in the organization's ongoing digital transformation, with a strong focus on cloud migration and an AI-driven transformation program.

In this role, you will support multiple Agile teams based in Belgium and internationally while working closely with stakeholders. You will be responsible for facilitating collaboration within and across teams, coaching Agile teams, and removing impediments that may impact delivery.

You will also collaborate with IT partners and business stakeholders on backlog management, prioritization, and ensuring clear communication between business and IT. In addition, you will contribute to dependency management, risk management, and a number of service management activities.

Profile

• You have several years of experience as a Scrum Master within an IT environment.
• You thrive in an international setting and know how to connect and coach teams across different locations and cultures.
• You are proactive, work independently, and actively contribute to strong team collaboration.
• You have excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

What are your responsibilities?

If you are also passionate about how users can safely access the network, how websites and applications can be published with strong authentication or how users can easily access the company network from anywhere in the world... Then you will certainly find what you are looking for with us.

This is what we expect from you:

• Monitoring and resolving problems to keep the network working properly.
• Design and implement new security principals to protect the IT environment.
• Providing technical support to the teams within the organizations.
• Collaborating with different departments on innovation.
• Keeping up with the latest industry trends and advising on new innovative solutions.
• You will report to the IT Infrastructure Manager.

Who are we looking for?

• You obtained a Master degree in IT or equivalent by experience.
• You have work experience in a complex and challenging environment.
• You are familiar with routing protocols, L2/L3, .1x, SDN
• You have experience with cisco networks, Fortinet and Darktrace
• Making Network Security combined, with end-user Security a reality based on different security layers.
• Ability to work independently and within a team.
• You combine a high analytical intelligence with strong problem solving skills.
• You are stress resistant and you love to work in a structured way.
• Good knowledge of Dutch and English.
• Short international business trips are not an issue for you.

A software company based in Gent is looking for an experienced Fullstack-Developer.

As a senior engineer, you are responsible for seamless coding, debugging, testing and coaching more junior developers.
Responsibilities
·Minimum 5 years of experience within software development

·Thorough knowledge of Java Backend Development

·Thorough knowledge of JavaScript ( Angular )

·Good understanding of the principles of Docker/ Kubernetes

·Good knowledge of Dutch and/ or French with English

·The willingness to acquire the necessary knowledge via self-learning

·Not afraid to give your opinion

Requirements
·Knowledge of Kafka is a big plus

·Knowledge of Cloud ( Azure or AWS )

·Knowledge of different databases

·Microservices knowledge is a plus

Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Application & Service Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
• Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
• Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
• Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
• Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
• Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.
IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

• Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.
• Monitor the quality and availability of workplace technologies, including hardware, networking, and telephony services.
• Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
• Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
• Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.
Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.
IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
• Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
• Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
• Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.
• Serve as a point of contact for audits and compliance-related activities.
• Support Business Continuity initiatives through planning, testing, and safeguarding critical business processes.

Profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 5 years of experience in an IT-related role.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate and drive initiatives forward.
• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
• Able to connect people, facilitate collaboration, and navigate across different levels of an organization.
• Strong organizational and administrative skills with great attention to detail.
• Quality-driven with a focus on service continuity and operational excellence.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a strong advantage.

Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience
• Experience with, or solid knowledge of, procedural programming, including:
 
• C
• COBOL
• PL/I
• Knowledge of relational databases, including:
 
• SQL
• DB2
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail
• Good command of French and/or Dutch, both written and spoken
• Good reading comprehension of technical English

Experience with or knowledge of the following technologies would be considered an asset:
 

• z/OS environment
• CICS
• JCL
• PL/I
• SOA / ESB
• TWS
• Web Services development
• Java
• Knowledge of accounting or financial principles

We are Team possible – the people behind Codit, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Davinsi Labs, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here! 
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world.  
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do.  
Sounds like your kind of place? 

Your job 

At Codit, we help organizations build and run digital solutions using Microsoft technology. 

We are looking for an Azure Infrastructure Architect with strong pre-sales focus to play a key role in:

• Designing, implementing, and evolving secure, scalable, and automated cloud environments for a diverse range of projects.
• Building trusted partnerships with customers, including C‑level leaders, by delivering clear, compelling technical insights and translating them into concrete solution architectures and actionable proposals. 
You’ll be a technical leader and trusted advisor with strong communication skills, combining hands-on expertise with customer-facing impact, helping Codit and our clients accelerate their cloud journeys through well-architected Azure platforms and landing zone solutions. 

Key Responsibilities 

What You’ll Do

• Lead technical pre-sales engagements (workshops, proposals, estimations, solution shaping)
• Translate customer challenges into solution architectures and commercial proposals
• Support account teams in deal positioning and closure
• Architect, design, and implement Azure platforms aligned with best practices.
• Lead the customization and modularization of Azure cloud infrastructure components to fit each client’s scale, security, and operational maturity.
• Define and enforce cloud governance, security, and compliance standards
• Automate infrastructure deployment using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Bicep, ARM, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, operations, and business stakeholders) to deliver robust, future-proof solutions.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to colleagues and contribute to internal knowledge sharing sessions.
• Stay up to date with Azure innovations, continuously improving Codit’s offerings. 

What You Bring

• Proven experience designing and deploying Azure infrastructure at scale
• Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership by translating technical realities into meaningful business insights and guiding decision‑makers with authority and credibility.
• Strong knowledge of Azure core services: networking, identity management, security, monitoring, and automation.
• Hands-on expertise with Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep, ARM, Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
• Experience with cloud governance, cost management, and compliance in regulated environments.
• Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, or equivalent) are highly valued.
• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch (French is a plus).
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset: you love a challenge and aren’t afraid to take initiative.
• A collaborative spirit and a sense of humor! 
Bonus Points

• Broad experience across the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (infrastructure, data, integration, and application services)
• Experience with multi-cloud, hybrid architectures or Sovereign solutions.
• Previous consulting or managed services experience.

We are Team possible – the people behind Codit, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Davinsi Labs, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here! 
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world.  
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do.  
Sounds like your kind of place? 

Your job 

As Domain Lead Integration, you are accountable for presales, technical delivery excellence and domain growth within Codit's Integration domain.

You combine deep expertise in Azure Integration Services and enterprise integration with strong leadership and customer-facing skills. You act as a trusted advisor for customers, a mentor for colleagues and a technical leader within Codit. 

Your responsibilities

• Lead technical pre-sales activities including workshops, assessments, estimations, PoCs, demos and solution shaping.
• Translate customer challenges into solution architectures, technical proposals and delivery approaches.
• Support account teams in opportunity development, positioning and closure.
• Define and evolve Codit's Integration vision, reference architectures and best practices.
• Ensure solutions are architected according to best practices for security, scalability, maintainability and observability.
• Guide architects and delivery teams on complex integration engagements.
• Align customer roadmaps with Codit's delivery and operational capabilities.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, Microsoft and strategic partners.
• Share knowledge, coach colleagues and drive competency growth within the Integration domain.
• Contribute to marketing initiatives, events and community activities.
• Take up billable architecture activities where appropriate. 

About You

You have:

• Minimum 10 years of experience in integration and cloud architecture.
• Strong expertise in Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, Azure Functions).
• Knowledge of integration patterns, API-led architectures, event-driven architectures and hybrid integration.
• Experience leading workshops, solution assessments and technical pre-sales engagements.
• Strong communication and presentation skills in both Dutch and English, towards technical and business stakeholders.
• The ability to align technical strategy with customer and business objectives.
• A coaching mindset and a passion for knowledge sharing.
• An entrepreneurial mindset with a strong customer focus.
